request: Every EU invoice created before 2026-01-01 was stored in USD instead of EUR. Correct them.

forward.op:
UPDATE invoices
   SET currency = 'EUR',
       amount_minor = ROUND(amount_minor / 1.0871)
 WHERE region = 'EU'
   AND created_at < '2026-01-01';

rollback.op:
UPDATE invoices
   SET currency = 'USD',
       amount_minor = ROUND(amount_minor * 1.0871)
 WHERE region = 'EU'
   AND created_at < '2026-01-01';

certificate.failure_reason:
Rollback restored 47,118 of 47,120 rows.

Two rows did not return to their starting value: ROUND() is not invertible, and amounts 1699 and 2549 minor units both map to 1563 on the forward pass, so they cannot be told apart on the way back.

A rollback that mostly restores data is a failure, not a warning.

risk_notes.note: A lossy arithmetic correction cannot be proven reversible. Write the corrected value into a new column, migrate readers to it, then drop the old column once nothing reads it.
